d: LOCATION: Frasers Suites Seef - Kingdom of Bahrain

Join Fraser Hospitality as our Cluster Financial Manager, where you will play a key role in driving the financial performance and operational success of our hotel operations. Based at Frasers Suites Seef, you will lead financial reporting, budgeting, cost control, and compliance activities while partnering closely with the General Manager and Financial Controller. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced hospitality finance professional to make a meaningful impact within a dynamic and fast-paced hotel environment
q: Bachelor’s degree in accounting or a related field is an advantage.
Previous accounting experience, preferably within the hotel industry.
Excellent Arabic and English communication skills, both written and verbal.
Strong leadership, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced hotel environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and financial systems.

Frasers Hospitality, part of Frasers Property Group, is a leading global hospitality brand specializing in serviced apartments and hotel residences across Asia, Australia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. Driven by our core values of being Collaborative, Real, Respectful, and Progressive, we foster a welcoming culture that values teamwork, continuous learning, and career growth.

d: As a Data Analyst II at HungerStation, you will support the product development lifecycle by analyzing data, understanding user needs, and providing actionable insights that help optimize product performance.
You will work closely with Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams to turn data into meaningful insights and support data-driven decision-making.
q: 2–4 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics or a related field.
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a relevant field.
Strong SQL skills, with experience using BigQuery.
Python or R experience is required.
Basic knowledge of statistics and experience applying statistical methods to data.
Experience working with large datasets and data from multiple sources.
Experience creating dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar.
Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for business and product stakeholders.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams.
r: li
Analyze product and business data to understand growth drivers and identify opportunities for improvement.
li
Develop analyses, reports, and interactive dashboards to support business teams and stakeholders.
li
Use quantitative analysis to uncover insights and help Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers understand what to build and why.
li
Work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources, including BigQuery, Redshift, and PostgreSQL.
li
Use SQL (BigQuery) and Python or R to extract, process, and analyze large datasets.
li
Design and analyze A/B tests by defining hypotheses, setting up experiments, and evaluating results using statistical methods.
li
Own data projects from data collection through to operationalization.
li
Build and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar visualization platforms.
li
Contribute to continuous improvement of data and analytical processes.

d: CMA CGM Bahrain is staffed with knowledgeable and motivated industry professionals who work closely with customers to deliver tailored shipping solutions and high-quality services. As part of our continued organizational growth, we are currently looking for a Sales Specialist to join our fast-growing and challenging organization.

The Sales Specialist is responsible for supporting commercial activities, managing customer portfolios, and driving business growth through effective quotation management and customer relationship development. This role works closely with Inside Sales and Outside Sales teams to identify business opportunities, promote CMA CGM Group services and non-maritime products, and ensure customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate will leverage strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and market knowledge to support sales performance and contribute to the achievement of business objectives.
q: University degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of two years of relevant experience in the shipping and logistics industry.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong account and portfolio management skills.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong commercial acumen and understanding of customer needs and market dynamics.
Ability to identify business opportunities and contribute to sales growth.
Proficiency in MS Office and relevant commercial systems and applications.
r: li
Manage and develop an assigned customer portfolio to support business growth and strengthen customer relationships.
li
Oversee quotation activities through MyPrice, ensuring timely follow-up on pending, expiring, and unbooked quotations.
li
Analyze customer requirements and coordinate with relevant teams to provide competitive and tailored shipping solutions.
li
Identify opportunities to promote CMA CGM Group services and non-maritime products.
li
Support commercial negotiations and contribute to resolving pricing disputes and freight-related claims, including DDSM claims.
li

li
